## Objective
- Build a complete, playable penalty shootout game based on the request: “FANS ANS 3 MISS STRIKE ANS REFREE AMD WIND AND GOOD OR BAD PENALTY TAKERS”.

## Requirements
- Implement the game or requested changes without asking clarifying questions.
- Make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks, viewport at most 1280px wide, and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Interpreted the request as adding visible crowd reactions, misses and strikes, a referee, wind effects, and selectable penalty takers with different skill levels.
- Added three fictional takers: Ace (96), Steady (74), and Rookie (48).

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a penalty taker selector and displayed the selected taker’s name and skill.
- Added variable wind speed and direction, affecting shot accuracy.
- Added a referee figure with different arm signals after goals and misses.
- Updated shot feedback to include strikes, misses, keeper saves, bar hits, and fan reaction text.
- Added responsive styling to keep taker and wind details visible on mobile.
- `node --check js/game.js` passed.

### Active
- Validate the game in a browser and inspect a current screenshot.
- Check for gameplay/UI issues and finish with a brief summary of assumptions.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run the game and verify it renders and plays on desktop and mobile layouts.
2. Save and inspect a latest small JPEG screenshot as requested.
3. Fix any issues found and report the changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI markup, including taker selection and wind display.
- `js/game.js`: Three.js scene, shootout gameplay, wind and taker mechanics, referee signals.
- `styles.css`: Game styling and responsive layout.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- The current game is a five-shot shootout; keyboard, pointer, and mobile controls already exist.

## Objective
- Complete the existing playable penalty shootout game with crowd reactions, misses and strikes, a referee, wind, and good/bad penalty takers.

## Requirements
- Implement the requested changes without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks (viewport no wider than 1280px) and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Use three fictional takers: Mara Vale (Ace, 96), Jules Okafor (Steady, 74), and Kit Rowan (Rookie, 48).
- Represent crowd reactions with fan-reaction text and wind-driven shot outcomes.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a taker selector, skill display, variable wind direction and speed, referee signals, and strike/save/bar/miss feedback.
- Verified `node --check js/game.js`.
- Started the game at `http://localhost:3000`; browser rendered the game and a charged keyboard shot completed with an updated score, callout, and wind reading.
- Captured and read `screenshots/validation-mobile.jpg` at 390×844.

### Active
- Fix and recheck mobile HUD layout: at 390×844, `.wind` is positioned at y=916 (offscreen), despite the `.bottom-meta` container being within the viewport.
- Complete responsive gameplay/UI validation after that fix.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect and adjust mobile `.wind`/`.bottom-meta` positioning in `styles.css`.
2. Recheck the mobile layout and gameplay in the browser; save and read a fresh small JPEG screenshot.
3. Run final syntax/status checks and report changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI, taker selector, wind details, and result overlays.
- `js/game.js`: Three.js scene and shootout gameplay, wind/taker mechanics, referee signals.
- `styles.css`: Main game styling and responsive mobile layout.
- `screenshots/validation-mobile.jpg`: Latest inspected mobile screenshot; capture a new one after fixing layout.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted in `index.html`, `js/game.js`, and `styles.css`.
- Desktop/browser runtime showed only a missing `/favicon.ico` 404 and WebGL readback performance warnings; game rendered and a shot played.
